## Outcome

Describe the user or contributor problem and resulting behavior.

## Issue and scope

Link the canonical issue. Identify a dependency if this is a stacked change.

## Verification

Record the checks that ran, supported versions exercised, and anything still unverified.

## Review notes

Explain relevant access, data, dependency, migration or compatibility effects.
Keep examples synthetic. Update documentation and a unique `changelog.d/<issue>-<slug>.md` fragment where applicable.
